heading: INT. ROOFTOP PIGEON COOP - BROOKLYN - EVENING

units.text: INT. ROOFTOP PIGEON COOP - BROOKLYN - EVENING
A lopsided wooden coop on a tar roof.
Wire mesh, birdseed, a hand-lettered sign reading "SQUAB SOCIAL CLUB - KEEP OFF."
The skyline glows behind.
GUS PIZZUTI (60s, club president, bathrobe over trousers) holds a clipboard.
His wife PAULETTE (60s, quilted vest) pours coffee from a thermos.
Their nephew BARNABY (30s, sales rep, headset around his neck) stands stiffly in a suit that does not belong on a roof.
Tonight's race. Eight birds, three hundred yards, winner takes the pot.
units.name: GUS

units.text: Uncle Gus, I really need to take this call.
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: Everyone needs to take a call. Sit.
units.name: GUS

units.text: Is there a chair?
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: There is an overturned bucket.
units.name: PAULETTE

units.text: Barnaby sits on the bucket with the dignity of a man being sentenced.
His headset buzzes.
He holds up a finger and answers.
Barnaby Sinclair, how can I help you.
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: Sinclair, where are you? The Henderson meeting started ten minutes ago.
units.name: BOSS

units.text: I'm, uh, on a site visit.
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: What site?
units.name: BOSS

units.text: It's a, it's a coop.
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: A what?
units.name: BOSS

units.text: A pigeon lands on Barnaby's head.
He freezes.
Don't move.
units.name: GUS

units.text: Don't move.
units.name: PAULETTE

units.text: Please somebody take it.
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: Sinclair! Is that a bird?
units.name: BOSS

units.text: It's a client.
units.name: BARNABY
